tei:div.tei:p: dmod bcol la/ bri ba'i skabs liṅga'i g.yas su lo dang zla ba la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: g.yon du zhag dang za ma la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: dus tshod tshes grangs la dgra dar ba thams= mdun du srog lus dbang thang klung rta la dgra dar ba thams= spyi bor dgra mgo thog tu babs pa thams= mgo nas g.yon skor du snga dgra lag gis bdar pa thams= phyi dgra yid la sems pa thams= da dgra khyi ltar zug pa thams= mgo la til rdung byed pa thams= sems la sdug bsngal gtong ba thams= lus la na tsha gtong ba thams= srog la bar chad gtong ba thams= zas nor la god kha gtong ba thams= rgyab nas ded shom byed pa thams= mdun na khyi bzhin sgug pa thams= zur nas gcod dgos zer ba thams= za lam du dug g.yos byed pa thams= 'gro lam du rtsang 'dzug pa thams= byams pa gnyan gyis brjod du ma bcug cig mā ra ya rbad nan: sdang ba dgra yis sgrog tu ma bcug= mi dpon gyis khrims ra na gleng du ma bcug= gtso bo'i 'dun khang na gleng du ma bcug= skye bo'i mda' gral na gleng du ma bcug= mo btsun gyi thags gral na gleng du ma bcug= byis pa'i rtse gral na gleng du ma bcug= mnyan pa'i gru tshugs su gleng du ma bcug= mgar gyi sol mal du gleng du ma bcug= dge 'dun gyi tshogs gral na gleng du ma bcug cig mā ra ya rbad nan: bon po'i tshogs gral na gleng du ma bcug= sngags pa'i phur gral na gleng du ma bcug= brgya kha mang gi mi kha zug pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan: stong mi mang gi kha mchu ngan pa thams= pha tsho'i 'dun khang nas mi kha gleng ba thams= gsod shom byed pa thams= rku shom byed pa thams= 'phrog shom byed pa thams= gros ngan shom pa thams= lkog nas 'bu bzhin 'bug pa thams= ngos la sprel ltar 'dzeg pa= keg bdud gshed gsum la babs pa= byad kha dang phur kha zug pa= rbad 'dre dang rbod gtong gtong ba= gnan sreg 'phang gsum byed pa=

mi kha dang dgra sna rlung ltar 'tshubs pa= mi kha dang dgra sna me ltar 'bar ba= mi kha dang dgra sna chu ltar 'brub pa= yul mi khyim mtshes kyi mi kha zug pa= rje khol skya ser gyi mi kha zug pa= nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra 'dre byur gsum= bstan dgra'i lus ngag yid gsum thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan sod cig: gzhan yang snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kyis za kha ston pa thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan/ chings shig mā ra ya rbad nan sod cig /bskal pa ma stongs kyi bar du ma gtang zhig /mā ra ya rbad nan sod cig /oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ st+waṃ bha ya nan: dgra bgegs sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad nan: 'di bri ba dang brjod pa gnyis ka bya'o/// /
